spec: Lake crossings (rivers keep their own fords). Each slotTiles x slotTiles square holds up to maxPerSlot crossings (at least minGap tiles apart): 'width'-wide lanes laid across the shortest bank-to-bank water runs (>= minRun) found on candidate lines every lineStep tiles (east-west and north-south, seeded offset). Runs up to fordMaxRun are fords (wade); longer runs up to ferryMaxRun get a ferry pontoon. stepCost is the navigator's per-tile weight so people only take a slow ferry when the walk round the lake is longer.
